tei:div.tei:p: ༈ bsngo ba rin po che'i phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs/

mkhyen pa'i ye shes brtse ba'i thugs rje can/ /mdzad pa'i phrin las skye rgu kun gyi dpal/ /dpal ldan bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba byang chub tu bsngo ba bshad de/ 'dir dge ba'i rtsa ba mi 'dzad cing gong nas gong du 'phel bar byed pa la byang chub tu bsngo ba gal che ste/ blo gros rgya mtshos zhus pa'i mdo las kyang*/ blo gros rgya mtsho 'di lta ste/ dper na mchil ma'i thigs pa gcig bye ma'i steng du bor na myur du skam par 'gyur ro/ /de nyid rgya mtsho chen por bor na ni ji srid rgya mtsho chen po zad cing skam par gyur pa de srid kyi bar du mchil ma'i thal ba de yang mi skam mo/ /blo gros rgya mtsho de bzhin du dge ba'i rtsa ba grub pa de yang 'gyod pa dang*/ phongs pa dang*/ dman par log bar bsngos na ni 'dzad la/ gang rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi ye shes kyi rgya mtsho chen por bsngos na mi 'dzad cing gong nas gong du 'phel lo/ /zhes gsungs pas bsngo ba bgyid 'tshal/ de la gang bsngo rgyu/ bsngo ba/ bsngo ba'i ched du bya ba/ bsngo ba'i rnam pa/ bsngo ba rang gi ngo bo dang lnga las/ bsngo rgyu dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis mtshon nas rang gzhan gyi dus gsum gyi dge ba yin te/ phal po che las/ 'gro kun dge ba ji snyed yod pa dang*/ / byas dang byed 'gyur de bzhin byed pa dang*/ /bzang po ji bzhin de 'dra'i sa dag la/ /kun nas kun kyang bzang por reg gyur cig /ces gsungs pas/ zhing dang dngos po bsam pa'i khyad par gyis mthong chos 'bras bu can gyi las zhes gsungs shing*/ zhing gi dbang du bgyis na dkon mchog gsum zhing dag pa yin te/ chos thams cad kyi rgyal po'i mdo las/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten na/ /dkon mchog gsum po ma gtogs pa'i/ /yon gyi zhing 'ga' yod min pas/ /dngos po kun gyis de la mchod/ /ces gsung pas/ de'i nang nas dge 'dun dkon mchog zhing sar bzang ba ste/

stong chen mo rab tu 'joms pa'i mdo las/ zhing rab gshin la sa bon btab pa las// dge 'dun dkon mchog rin chen mchog tu gsungs/ /zhes pa dang*/ slob dpon klu sgrub kyi zhal snga nas/ 'phags pa min yang pha ma dang*/ /nad pa dang ni chos smra dang*/ /skye mtha'i byang chub sems dpa' la/ /yon phul gzhal du med par gsungs/ /zhes gsungs/ dngos po gang zhig sdig dang ma 'dres shing*/ /dge 'dun la sogs phan bde skyed pas te/ /zhes gsungs/ mdo sde rgyan las/ rgyal sras rnams kyi brtse bas sbyin pa ni/ kha na ma tho med cing dag pa yin/ /bde ba 'dren pa byis pa'i snying dang ni/ /rjes su bsrung bcas 'chol dang gol sa med/ /ces gsungs/ bsam pa tshe 'di'i snyan grags dang lan la sogs pa 'khor ba'i sems dang bral ba gal che ste/ slob dpon rta dbyangs kyi zhal nas/ dge ba'i rtsa ba bsgrubs pa de dag kyang*//grags dang snyan dang lha mi'i bde 'bras dang*/ /re bcas 'khor ba'i sems dang rnam bral te/ /'jig rten 'das pa nyid kyi rgyur bsngo 'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /bsngo ba ni rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid yin te/ yongs su bsngo ba'i mdo las/ dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di dag kyang*/ /sangs rgyas nyid kyi rgyur bsngo'o/ /zhes gsungs/ ched du bya ba ni sems can don du bsngo'o/ /slob dpon zhi ba lha'i zhal nas kyang*/ lus dang de bzhin longs spyod dang*/ /dus gsum dge ba'i dngos po rnams/ /sems can kun gyi don bsgrub phyir//phongs pa med par btang bar bya/ /zhes gsungs/ bsngo ba'i rnam pa ni kun rdzob chos thams cad rmi lam sgyu ma tsam la/ don dam pa rang bzhin mtshan ma med pa'i tshul gyis shes par bya ste/ ting 'dzin rgyal po'i mdo las/ ji ltar mtshan mo chu yi zla ba dag /dwangs shing rnyog pa med pa'i mtshor snang yang*/ /chu zla stong pa gsob ste snying po med/ /chos rnams thams cad de ltar shes par gyis/ /de ltar chu shing rlon pa'i sdong po la/

/snying po 'dod phyir de dag gshags gyur kyang*/ /nang dang phyi rol kun na snying po med/ /chos rnams thams cad de ltar shes par gyis/ / zhes pa dang*/ ljon pas zhus pa mdo las/ me long dkyil 'khor yongs dag la/ /ji ltar rang bzhin med pa yi/ /bzhin gyi dkyil 'khor snang ba bzhin// ljon pas chos rnams shes par gyis/ /zhes gsungs so/ /don dam par bsod nams kyang mtshan ma med par yang*/ sdud par/ gal te mtshan mar byed na byang chub bsngo ma yin/ /ci ste mtshan ma med na byang chub bsngo ba yin/ /zhes gsungs pas/ dge ba'i rtsa ba dang*/ bdag nyid dang*/ bsag bya'i cha thams cad mdang sum gyi rmi lam gyi nang na snang ba tsam du snang la ngos bzung med pa'i ngang nas/ bsngo ba'i ngo bo rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu 'dun cing bsgyur bas/ bsngo ba 'grub pa'i dpang por/ mdun gyi nam mkha' dkyil du bla ma dang sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pa byon nas bzhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod la/ mthun 'gyur dang rjes zlos mdzod cig /phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i bla ma dang sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas/ tshe thog ma med pa nas da lta'i bar du sbyin pa las byung ba dang*/ tshul khrims las byung ba dang*/ sgom pa las byung ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di dag thams cad gcig tu bsdus shing bsdoms nas/ nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa'i sems can thams cad dang thun mong gcig tu byas nas/ sbyin pa dam pa sems kyi rgyan dang sems kyi yo byad rnal 'byor gyi tshogs/ don gyi mchog /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang rin po che myur du thob par gyur cig /de ma thob kyi bar du yang bde 'gro mtho ris 'jig rten lha dang mi rnams kyi nang du skye bar gyur cig /de yang tshe ring ba rnams kyi nang nas mchog tu gyur cig /nad med pa rnams kyi nang nas mchog tu gyur cig

/longs spyod che ba dang*/ gzugs bzang ba/ gzi brjid che ba btsan phyug che ba rnams kyi nang nas mchog tu gyur cig /de ltar gyur nas dge ba'i bshes gnyen mthun pa'i zhabs drung du skye bar gyur cig /de dag la theg pa chen po'i chos thos par gyur cig /de dag gi don nyams su blangs nas sa dang lam thams cad rdzogs par byas te/ bla na med pa'i byang chub chos kyi sku nyid thob par gyur cig /de kho na nyid du 'grub gyur cig / lan gsum brjod/ gshin gson thun mong gi bsngo ba'o/ / da ni thun mong ma yin pa'i bsngo ba gong 'og bya ba ni/ gtam gyi rjes la bsngo ba zhu mi kun thal mo sbyar nas/ che ge mo'i phyogs nas skye ba sngon ma bsod nams khyad par can bsags pa la brten nas 'dzam bu'i gling yul dbus dam chos dar ba'i phyogs su dal 'byor gyi mi lus rin po che thob cing*/ rigs rgyud cho 'brang phun sum tshogs pa/ kun gyi khur du mi 'gro zhing mi chos kyi rgyan zer ba'i tshul du yod pa lags na'ang*/ bcom ldan 'das kyis spyir 'dus byas thams cad kyi mtshan nyid mi rtag cing*/ khyad par du skyes bu'i tshe mi rtag gsungs pa de nyid khong gi thog tu babs nas dgung tshad du thal gda'/ 'on kyang srid na mi srid pa gcig byung ba ma yin/ thams cad kyi mtshan nyid de las ma 'das te/ rgya che rol ba las/ srid gsum mi rtag ston ka'i sprin dang 'dra/ /skyes bu'i tshe 'gro ri gzar chu dang mtshungs/ /zhes pa dang*/ mi rtag pa'i tshoms las/ skye nas gang zhig ma shi ba/ /'ga' zhig khyod kyis mthong ba'am/ /'on te thos dang the tshom za/ /'di ltar skyes pa thams cad kyi/ /mdun na 'chi bdag gnas bcas te/ /kun kyang 'pho bar snang ba'i phyir/ /mya ngan gnas pa rigs ma yin/ /zhes gsungs pas/ /skyes pa'i mtha' 'chi/ /'dus pa'i mtha' 'bral/ /bsags pa'i mtha'adzad/ / 'byor mtha' rgud pa zhig las ma 'das/

bsags pa'i rdzas kyis mi stongs/ dbang dang drag gis mi skyob/ nye du dang 'brel ba kun bzhag nas/ gcig pur mar gyi gseb nas spu bton pa bzhin du 'gro dgos pa'i dus shig 'ong gsungs pa de khong thog tu babs pa la/ khyed rnam pas khong gi don du dge gtong ra mda' mdzad pa ni shin tu phan par gsungs te/ bu mo rin chen gyis zhus pa'i mdo las/ 'chi ba'i dus la babs pa na/ /su dag skyabs su mi 'gro zhing*/ /pha ma ma yin gnyen 'dun min/ /de tshe bsod nams skyabs gcig pu/ /zhes pa dang*/ rgyal po la gdams pa'i mdo las kyang*/ dus kyis gnyer te rgyal po 'gro 'gyur na/ /longs spyod mdza' dang gnyen bshes rjes mi 'brang*/ /skyes bu dag ni gar gnas gar song yang*/ /las ni grib ma bzhin du rjes su 'brang*/ /zhes gsungs pas/ /las dge sdig gnyis tshe 'das kyi rjes su 'brang zhing*/ dge ba bsngos pas tshe 'das de yang brgya la ngan song du skyes kyang myur du thar ba thob par bshad de/ 'dul ba lung las/ sngon grong khyer rdo 'jog tu 'phags pa ka ta ya na byon nas/ shan pa gcig la mtshan mo srog gcod spong bar gdams/ des kyang mtshan mo srog mi gcod par sdom pa nos pa las/ de dus las 'das pa'i 'og tu sngar gyi mi dge ba'i rgyus nyi tshe ba'i dmyal bar skyes nas/ nyin mo sdug bsngal zhing mtshan mo lha'i longs spyod dang ldan pa la/ tshe dang ldan pa gro zhun skyes kyis de ltar 'ong ba'i rgyu dris pas/ nyin mo srog bcad pas sdug bsngal lo/ /mtshan mo sdom pa nod pas bde'o/ khyed 'dzam bu'i gling du 'byon na nga'i bu kun la srog gcod spongs la nga'i don du bsngo ba zhus zer ro/ /gro zhun skyes kyis sngar gyi phrin bgyis pas/ shan pa de'i bus kyang de bzhin du nyan pas/ 'phags pa ka ta ya na la pha'i don du bsngo ba zhus pas nyi tshe ba'i sdug bsngal las thar te sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lhar skyes nas bden pa mthongagasungs so/

/de bas na dus 'das kun gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba grangs kyis bcad cing*/ sdig pa dang 'tshe ba ma byas na thar pa thob ste/ 'on kyang las 'di shin tu cha phra bas tshe 'das brgya la ngan song du skyes na/ de las thar pa'i thabs bsngo ba rin po che lag cha yin te/ de la bsngo rgyu/ bsngo ba/ ched du bya ba/ rnam pa/ ngo bo dang lnga las/ bsngo rgyu dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis mtshon pas rang gzhan gyi dus gsum gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad/ bsngo ba rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi sar/ ched du bya ba tshe 'das kyis thog drangs pa'i sems can gyi don du'o/ /rnam pa kun rdzob dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis mtshon pa'i chos thams cad rmi lam sgyu ma ltar snang la rang bzhin med pa/ don dam par rang bzhin spros pa'i mtshan ma thams cad dang bral ba'i ngang nas/ ngo bo dge rtsa rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu 'dun cing bsgyur ba'i bsngo ba 'grub pa'i dpang por mdun gyi nam mkha' sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pa byon nas bzhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ /tshe las 'das pa yang kha lag dang skye mched gsal ba thal mo sbyar te yong bar dmigs la/ gral na bzhugs pa rnams kyis mthun 'gyur dang*/ khyed rang rnams tshe 'das la brtse ba'i sgo nas rjes zlos mdzod cig /phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag cag rnams kyis tshe las 'das pa'i don du sbyin pa las byung ba dang*/ tshul khrims las byung ba dang*/ sgom pa las byung ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba bgyis pa dang*/ bgyid du stsal ba dang*/ gzhan gyis bgyis pa la rjes su yi rang ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis/ 'jig rten 'di nas pha rol tu dus las 'das pa che ge mo zhes bgyi bas thog drangs/ nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa'i sems can thams cad dang thun mong gcig tu byas te/ myur du rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pas sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig

/de ma thob kyi bar tshe las 'das pa che ge mo zhes bya ba/ gal te las kyi dbang gis 'gro ba rigs drug skye ba rnam bzhi/ srid pa bar ma do gang dang gang du skye ba'i las can cig yin na'ang*/ dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di 'jig rten 'di nas pha rol du song ba'i tshe las 'das pa che ge zhes bya ba'i phyi bzhin du 'brang zhing phyi bzhin du rjes su 'jug par gyur cig /dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di dag phyi bzhin du rjes su 'brang zhing phyi bzhin du rjes su zhugs nas kyang*/ tshe las 'das pa che ge mo zhes bgyi bar dmyal ba'am/ yi dwags sam/ dud 'gro'am/ lha dang*/ lha ma yin la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal gyi bye brag kun las thar bar gyur cig /thar nas kyang bde 'gro mtho ris kyi 'jig rten du lha dang mi rnam gnyis kyi nang du phyin par gyur cig /dkon mchog gsum gyi sgra thos pa gyur cig /de thos nas kyang dkon mchog la dad par gyur cig /mngon par dad nas bslab pa'i gzhi mtha' dag la slob par gyur cig /theg pa chen po'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams dang mjal bar gyur cig /de dag las theg pa zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos thos par gyur cig /thos nas kyang de dag gi don nyams su blangs te sa lam thams cad rdzogs par byas nas bla na med pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sku thob par gyur cig /'o des tshe las 'das pa'i don du bsngo ba 'grub pa lags pas khong la shin tu phan par gsungs/ khrel can gyis mya ngan bgyid par rjes su yi rang*/ khyed rnam pa'i thugs dgongs la de ltar bsgrubs pa'i dge ba de/ tshe las 'das pa min pa gzhan gyis mi thob snyam na/ de ltar ma yin te/ gzhan don sgrub pa des kyang khyad par rang gi rgyud dge ba shin tu rgya chen po thob ste/ rgya mtshos zhus pa'i mdo las kyang*/ 'di ltar dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams/ /rang don nyid dang gzhan don du/ /mngon par sgrub pa'i bsod nams dang*/ /rgya mtsho ba lang rmig rjes kyi/

khyad par gang yin de dang mtshungs/ /zhes pa dang*/ spyod 'jug las kyang*/ byis pas rang gi don byed dang*/ /thub pas gzhan gyi don byed gnyis/ /'di nyid kyi ni khyad par ltos/ / zhes pa dang*/ gtsug na rin po ches zhus pa'i mdo las kyang*/ rigs kyi bu de la rang don du dge ba'i rtsa ba bsgrubs pa de dag kyang srin bu me khyer lta bu'o/ /gzhan don du dge ba'i rtsa ba bsgrubs pa de ni nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor lta bu'o/ /zhes gsungs pas/ khyed rnam pas de ltar 'bad pa'i dge ba'i rtsa bas mtshon te/ rang gzhan gyi dus gsum dang 'brel ba'i dge ba rnams thugs kyi dkyil du bsdoms la/ kun rdzob sgyu ma rmi lam tsam du don byed pa/ /rang bzhin spros pa'i mtha' las 'das pa'i tshul gyis/ bsngo bya sngo byed bsngo ba'i yul mi dmigs pa'i sgo nas/ snang brnyan tsam du bsngo ba 'grub pa'i dpang por/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pa mdun gyi nam mkhar byon nas bzhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod la rjes zlos mdzod cig /sbyin pa rgya cher gyur pa 'di yis ni/ /zhes sogs brjod/ yang na/ bsod nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa nyid/ /ces pa la sogs pa'am/ sangs rgyas sku gsum brnyes pa'i byin rlabs dang*/ /chos nyid mi 'gyur bden pa'i byin rlabs dang*/ /dge 'dun mi phyed 'dus pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /bdag gis ji ltar bsngos bzhin 'grub par shog /'o des bsngo ba gong 'og dang bcas pa grub pa lags pas shin tu rjes su yi rang ngo*/ /rab dkar dge legs bsngo ba'i rgyal po 'di/ /yang dag lung gi phreng bas spras pa 'di/ /mang du thos pa'i bshes gnyen bsam yas pas/ /don gnyer skye bos bskul phyir don du brtsams/ /dge ba 'di yis bdag dang 'gro ba kun/ /phun tshogs bsod nams ye shes tshogs bsags te/ /chos sku'i mkha' la longs sku'i sprin 'khrigs nas/ /sprul sku'i char gyis 'gro ba bsil bar shog

/tshul khrims blo gros bsam yas pa yis sbyar ba rdzogs so// //dge'o/ / / na mo gu ru madzñu gho ṣā ya/ /rgyal kun spyi gzigs pad+mā ka ra dang*/ / rnam dbyer mi phyed khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon/ /'jam dbyangs dgyes zhal mkhyen brtse'i dbang po yi/ /zhabs zung zla ba snying gi pad mtshor rol/ / gdod ma'i rgyal khab che las mtshan dpe'i dpyid/ /rdo rje slob dpon gzugs su rang snang ba/ /kun bzang chos sku'i rnam rol klong chen pa/ /dri med 'od zer dad brgya'i gtsug gis mchod/ /dgongs brda' snyan nas brgyud pa'i khyad par las/ /zab gsang theg pa'i chos sgo mtha' klas pa/ / rnam mkhyen shing rta'i 'gros kyis snang byed mgon/ /bstan 'dzin mchog gi bka' drin yang yang dran/ /rnam dkar zla ba'i lang tsho cha gang ba'i/ /legs spyad 'jug sgo ji snyed 'dzin mdzad pa/ /dam pa'i phrin las ma smad tshul bzang pos/ /chos sbyin phyi mo ji ltar bsgrubs tshul dgod/ /de la sras dang bcas pa'i rgyal ba rab 'byams mtha' dag gi thugs rje dang phrin las yongs su rdzogs pa'i mnga' bdag khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po mnyam med kun mkhyen rgyal ba klong chen rab 'byams zhes mtshan snyan gyi bla bres nam mkha'i pha mthar khebs pa gang nyid kyi zhal snga nas legs par stsal ba'i zab chos/ mdo sngags rgyal ba'i bka' gsang dgongs 'grel gyi tshul du snang bar mdzad pa bsam yas zhig mchis pa las/ snying tig rnam bzhi sogs phal cher snga phyir dam pa mang po'i bka' drin gyis spar gyi 'phrul du 'du 'god byung zin pa dang*/ khyad par mdzod chen bdun dang ngal gso skor gsum sogs ni mnyam med rdzogs chen mchog sprul 'gyur med theg mchog bstan 'dzin gyi thugs bskyed dang phrin las kyi sgo nas chos sbyin gyi sgo chen phyes shing*/ /de dag kun kyang chos skyong ba'i mnga' bdag mi yi tshangs pa rim byon 'dzam gling gangs can tsam na 'gran zla dang bral ba sde bzhi dang dge bcus nor 'dzin yangs pa'i khyon rnams skyong zhing*/

phan bde kun gyi 'byung gnas rgyal bstan rin po che dgung du 'degs pa'i mnga' thang dang phrin las rgya mtsho'i gos can ji snyed kyi khor yug tu khyab pa de nyid kyi bdag rkyen la brten nas byung ba dgongs gzhir byas te skabs 'dir rnam dkar sgrub pa po ni ji skad du/ dam pa khas 'che mang po mi byed cing*/ /gal te dka' ba'i gnas ni khas blangs na/ /rdo la ri mo bris pa ji bzhin du/ /nam yang gzhan du byed par mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes pa ltar g.yar dam don du gnyer zhing*/ kun mkhyen chen po'i phrin las yid bzhin nor bu'i phreng ba'i lhag ma rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mor 'god pa'i thugs bskyed phul du byung ba zhig ste/ pha mes nas kong tsha zhes pa'i rigs rgyud bzang zhing spyir btang spyod pa zho shas 'tsho ba'i rigs las chad cing*/ mes po bsod nams bzang po rig byed mang po'i mkhyen rab dang ldan pas rdzogs chen mchog sprul 'gyur med theg mchog bstan 'dzin gyi slob ma byas/ de'i bu ser skya 'ga' re yod pa'i mgon po phun tshogs kyis rdzogs chen gsum pa nges don bstan 'dzin bzang po'i gsol dpon zhabs phyi yang rab zin cing*/ dpon kun grol rnam rgyal gyi slob mar gyur/ rgyun tu khro chu dang bduda'adul gro lod kyi bsnyen sgrub la brtson/ de'i tsha bo rdzogs chen phyag mdzod chos skyong bkra shis rgyal rong nam mkha' dang*/ gling gter pad+ma 'gro 'dul dang*/ dpa' bo las rab rtsal rnams bla mar bsten/ ma ṇi dung phyur dang phur bsnyen dung phyur sogs bzlas brjod bzang zhing*/ rdzogs sprul bzhi pa sku+u na gzhon dus nas bzung snga phyir phyag mdzod lo nyer lnga'i bar du byas/ dbus byon dang dbang lung gsan bzhes sogs kyi zhal phyi gang ci'i las sgo phul du phyin pa grub/ de'i gcung kun bzang gzhan phan gyis rdzogs sprul rin po che'i gsol dpon zhabs phyi lo mang du byas/

bslab pa'i gnas la gces spras che bas dge slob bzang rab kyi gral du phyin/ de gnyis kyi spun zla khyim gnas kyi bur srid pa nye bar bzung ba na/ sngon gyi las smon mtha' gcig tu dkar ba'i 'bras bu dus su son pas yab dang yum gyis rgyal bstan rin po che'i sgor bcug cing yi ge slob pa sogs bza' lam du ci tshud byas/ bgrang bya cung zad nar son cing mno bsam shes nas bzung rig lam gyi sbyangs rtsol ci rigs dang*/ khyad par zhe chen ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta 'gyur med mthu stobs rnam par rgyal ba'i sde la sogs pa gsar rnying gi yongs 'dzin dam pa chos kyi spyan ldan du ma'i zhabs kyi pad+mor yang nas yang du bsnyen te phyi nang gi rig pa'i gnas chen lnga yan lag dang bcas pa la mkhyen rab kyi rtse mor son pas dam pa'i skyes bu'i mtshan snyan gyis brjid pa sum ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa'i slob dpon rdo rje rab brtan nam/ kun bzang rnam rol bshad sgrub nyi ma zhes/ grags pa'i ba dan dkar po sring rtser g.yo ba gang nyid kyis spyir spong klog bya ba las kyi 'khor lo gsum dang 'brel ba'i sgo nas rang gzhan gyi don gnyis mdzad pa dang*/ yang sgos su snga 'gyur bka' gter rgya mtsho'i 'byung gnas rdzogs chen rang dgon dang*/ dpal yul rnam rgyal byang chub chos gling gtsos rnying bstan 'dzin pa'i dgon gnas mang por/ 'dus pa mdo dang sgyu 'phrul gtso bor gyur pa'i snga 'gyur bka' gter gyi sgrub phrin zab mo du ma'i phyag bzhes 'khrul med tshad thub kyi lam srol rgya cher phyes pas mtshon te/ rlabs chen dam pa'i phrin las rgya mtsho'i dpal la co 'dri gnang zhing*/ skabs 'dir yang dad ldan dag gis 'di phyi'i skyabs rten du phul ba'i dngos rdzas ci mchis gnas min du dron zag ma yin par/ dam pa'i chos sbyin phyi mo'i 'char rkyen dmigs nas/ ljon 'dab 'khor drug brgya dang bco lnga 'dong nges la gzhir byas/

skyabs mgon thams cad mkhyen gzigs 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'i spyan sngar thal mo sbyar te rgyu mtshan snyan du gsol ba na bstod tshogs skor spar du bzhengs pa'i 'gan bzhes rkang thub thog /'khor drug nyi shu'i dngos po smar nges ched du stsal pa dang*/ gzhan yang rnam dkar zhal 'debs su dmigs pa'i sgo nas rgyal rong bla brang nas rta pho gcig /tsha nyag bla ma shes rab nas rta pho dngul bzhi ru ri pa dang mdzo sar/ phug khang bla ma rnam grol nas ras dkar yug /bla ma stobs rgyal nas ras dmar 'dom do bcas byung zhing*/ ring mo nas rnam dkar gyi bya ba la ches cher goms shing gtong ba'i phyag ring yangs por rkyong pa'i 'jug ldang zad mi shes pa'i rang mtshan mngon du gsal ba sa skyong chos dbyings bzang mos spar shing sogs ched gnang dang do dam gyi mgo 'dren gang la gang dgos bka' drin chen pos khyab pa'i bdag rkyen la brten nas kun mkhyen chen po'i gsung rab thor bu'i phyogs deng sang khams dbus su ci mchis kun gzigs rdo rje 'chang mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos bka' bsdu mdzad pa'i dkar chag nyid snga ma'i dkar chag mjug tu sbrel ba ltar/ zhu dag kyang rje bla ma'i zhal nas mkhas dbang dam pa nyid la nan tan gyis shig pa'i bka' phebs dang lhan cig phyag dpe pu sta kaḥm phyir gnang ba bzhin zhib mor gzigs pa'i skabs su/ gna' dus nas yig nor rgyun 'byams dang*/ chad lhag gi skyon che bas phyi mo gang rnyed rnams dang dpe bsdur thog /yi ge'i nor 'khrul byung nges rnams btang snyoms su ma lus par zhun thar gang che dang*/ lkog gyur mkhyen pa'i stobs dang ldan na ma gtogs mi shes shing blo gros kyi sgor ma smin pa'i rigs slad nas dpyod ldan dag gis 'chos dgos pa'i gtan tshigs gnang ba las gzu lums dang 'ol tshod ma mdzad cing*/ spyir zhib cha gang che'i lugs su grub pa'i ngo mtshar spar gyi dngos po gang zhig yid bzhin nor bu bye ba phrag stong gis mtshon du med pa'i legs byas rmad du byung ba nyid yongs su bskrun par gyur to/

/rgya che'i rang bzhin nam mkha'i rjes 'gro dam pa'i phyag ris 'bab stegs mthor/ /ci 'dir 'dzegs pa'i skal bzang gzhon du tshangs chen blo mthus yongs bzung mod/ /bstan dang 'gro ba'i dge legs lam srol 'jig rten khams su 'byung ba'i rgyu/ /'chi med grong gi ljon pas mtshon min dad brtson 'phrul las byung 'di rmad/ /thabs chen bsod nams 'khor gsum yongs shes kyi/ /shes rab zab mos zin pa'i legs spyad mthus/ /phan bde'i 'byung gnas rgyal bstan rin po che/ /srid pa ji srid nub med dar rgyas shog /rnam 'dren nyi ma'i phrin las shing rta sna tshogs dngos po'i rkang bkod pas/ /yid can gdul bya'i rmongs mun 'jil dang bde legs snang ba sbyin mkhas pa/ /rgyal sras tshul 'chang gang na su bzhugs skye 'gro'i dpal mgon dam pa ru/ /bskal pa rgya mtsho'i ji srid yun du 'tsho gzhes gnang ba'i rgyur gyur cig /'di na cung zad tsam yang rung*/ / 'brel thogs gang yin de dag kyang*/ /myur du rnam mkhyen rgyal ba yi/ /go 'phang thob pa'i rgyu gyur cig /rtsod dus snyigs sogs 'jig rten rgud byed ma rungs yid srub gdug pa'i dpung*/ /lhan cig mi gnas ring du bskal bas rdzogs ldan dang po'i dus ston mgron/ /gsar du khugs pa'i nyer len gzhi dang blang dor ma nor lta ba'i mig /mtha' dag ma ma sdug gus rnyed pa'i gnyen bzang dam par 'dis gyur cig /'phags bzhi so skye ji snyed yongs kyi bsod nams ye shes mtha' yas sgor/ /yi rangs gtsug gis rtse gcig btud bcas 'dir 'bad dge rtsa ci mchis des/ /nam mkha'i khyon gang 'gro khams rgya mtshos slob dang mi slob zung 'jug che/ /mngon mtho'i dpal gyis zur nas 'degs bzhin gtan bde de nyid brnyes gyur cig / rab dkar ston zla'i dpal la 'khu ba'i dad sbyin so so'i don gnyer gyis/ / brtan g.yo'i dge mtshan yongs su 'phel zhing rnam mkhyen btsas su 'dun ldan pa'i/

/rgyu mtshan 'di yis bkra shis dpal 'bar brgya byin dbang po'i lha yi rnga/ /rgya cher sgrogs gang gtan du mi 'gyur phun tshogs phrin las rab rgyas shog /ces pa'ang rgyal sras 'jam dbyangs chos kyi nyi ma blo gros rgyas pa'i sdes smras pa dge legs bkra shis mtha' dag shrī māṃ gu ṇa sid+dhi rastu// //
